guidebook.intro: The kingdom of Buganda, told in Ateso. Teso had no king; elders and clan leaders ruled.

tips.title: Erwosit: the king
body: **Erwosit** is king, **apugan** government or rule, **epugi** he rules. **Kitolomaa ŋinipak!** (live for ever!) answers **Kabaka awangaale!**.

tips.title: Ekiko and the prime minister
body: **Ekiko** is the Lukiiko, the parliament; **ekapolon ka ikanam** is the prime minister (leader of the council). **Ekal ka erwosit** is the palace.

culture.title: Rule by elders
body: Before colonial times the Iteso were governed by age-sets and clan elders, not kings. Today the **Emorimor** is the cultural leader of the Iteso.
